workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Hi Brad, I've checked Priya and Marcus's calendars. workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Thanks Brad. I checked Elena+David's free slots against Priya and Marcus's calendars. Most conflict with Priya, but there's one potential match: Thu 14:30-15:00. Priya is free then. Marcus is also free 14:30-15:00 (he has Dentist 14:30-15:00 - wait, let me recheck... Marcus has Dentist appointment Thu 14:30-15:00, so he's busy). 

Actually, checking more carefully - none of the Elena+David slots work for both Priya AND Marcus. Here's what I found:
- Mon 11:00-12:00: Priya busy (Travel 11:00-11:30, Contract review 11:30-12:00)
- Tue 9:00-10:00: Priya busy (Board prep 9:00-9:30, Partner lunch 9:30-10:00)
- Wed 13:00-14:00: Priya busy (Client call 13:00-13:30, Client dinner prep 13:30-14:00)
- Thu 9:30-10:00: Priya busy
- Thu 14:30-15:30: Marcus busy (Dentist 14:30-15:00)
- Fri 15:00-16:00: Priya busy (Hiring panel 15:00-15:30, Contract review 15:30-16:00)

It appears there are no overlapping slots for all four partners. Should we report this as infeasible, or is there something I'm missing?
